approved_marketed.name: FREEDOM Infusion System (FREEDOM60 / FreedomEdge syringe drivers, HIgH-Flo and Precision Flow Rate Tubing, needle sets)
approved_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA-cleared for subcutaneous drug delivery; primary commercial use is delivery of subcutaneous immunoglobulin (SCIg) for Primary Immunodeficiency Disease (PIDD) and Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP); also sold to biopharma sponsors as a delivery device for their Phase I-III subcutaneous drug trials

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-device company. KORU Medical develops and sells the FREEDOM Infusion System (FDA-cleared subcutaneous drug-delivery devices) and provides infusion-system hardware plus non-recurring engineering (NRE) services to biopharmaceutical sponsors for their own Phase I-III subcutaneous drug programs. KORU does not sponsor or own any drug or device clinical trials of its own; clinicaltrials.gov returns zero KORU/Repro-Med-sponsored studies.
